description.zh:
镜像打包上传成功后是否自动释放实例，仅支持构建机。

- true：释放实例时，该镜像随实例一起释放。
- false ：释放实例时，保留该镜像，不随实例一起释放。
- 为空则表示默认为false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic release of the instance after the image is packaged and uploaded. This parameter is supported only for build instances.

- true: The image is released together with the instance when the instance is released.
- false: The image is retained when the instance is released.
- If this parameter is left empty, the default value is false.

description.zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
description.en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 镜像要存储的目标OSS的区域。
description.en: The region of the destination OSS bucket where the image is stored.

description.zh: 创建镜像是否包含数据盘。
description.en: Specifies whether to include data cloud disks when creating the image.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-image --instance-id i-5rr1bnyrc4tswr8cq3w6y0000 --image-name ImageName --delete-after-image-upload false --snapshot-id s-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --target-oss-region-id cn-beijing --with-data-disks true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CreateImage --region cn-hangzhou --ImageName ImageName --SnapshotId 's-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --InstanceId 'i-5rr1bnyrc4tswr8cq3w6y0000' --WithDataDisks true --TargetOSSRegionId 'cn-beijing' --DeleteAfterImageUpload false
